entities.name: 5GSM cause
entities.description: Information element indicating the reason for a 5G session management procedure failure or specific condition.

entities.name: PDU session type mismatch
entities.description: Condition where the selected PDU session type differs from the PDU session type requested by the UE.

relations.description: The 5GSM cause IE is included when there is a mismatch between selected and requested PDU session types.
